content: Jesus Calls the First Disciples
Noqw sinom God lavayiyat nanaptaniqe put aw hūrs tsovawtaqw, pam wuhkovatuphat Gennesaret yan mātsiwhqat qalaveq wunu.
Nihqe pam lȫqmuy pākihut patuphat qalaveq wúnuhqat tuwa, noqw kurs pakiwmamahk̇am pumuy aṅqw nö́ṅakqe, pakiwmaqtutsayay tūvahomtota.
Noqw pam pākihut hakiy Simon himuyat aqw paki; nihqe pam tutskwat aṅqw híhin yūmo hóyoknaniqat aw paṅqawu; noqw pam pepeq qatuptuqe, pākihut aṅqw sinmuy tutuqayna.
Pu ōviy pam yuaataqe yukut, Simon aw paṅqawu: Uma pavan hötsit aw hóyok̇e’, pāvakiwhtuy inhtaniqe ōviy umuhtutsayay pāmiq pánani.
Noqw Simon lavayhtiqe put aw paṅqawu: Moṅwi, itam as tōk̇ep tumalay’tat, qa hihta kwisna, noqw pay pi um paṅqawhq ōviy nu tutsayat pāmiq pánani.
Noqw puma panhtiqe, pahsat pu qaan’ewakw hintaqamuy pāvakiwhtuy inhta; noqw pumuy tutsáyaam tsīkiwma.
Noqw suṅwámat sukwat pākihut aṅqw taṅawtaqw, puma pumuy amumi māmasa pumuy paaṅwaniqat ōviy’o. Noqw puma pituqw, puma lȫqmuy pākihut akw ohpoknayaqw, pahsat pay puma pākihut pakito.
Noqw Simon Peter put aw yórikqe, Jesus tamöyat aw nātuvat paṅqawu: Inuṅaqw ahpiy’o, taq nu okiw qaanhinmaqa, Tutuyqawhqa.
Pi pam‐niqw, pu sohsoyam put ámumyaqam puma pāvakiwhtuy inhtotaqey ep kātayyuṅqw, ōviy pam yan lavayhti.
Noqw piw hakiy Zebedeet timat James‐niqw pu John, Simon suṅwámatnihqam, puma pumuy amún nātsawina. Noqw Jesus Simon aw paṅqawu: Um qa tsawiniwtani, um yahpiy haqahpiy pāpu sinmuy kwīkwisnani.
Noqw puma pākihuy tutskwami pitsínayaqe, sohsok tatamhtotat, Jesus aṅkya.
Jesus Makes a Leper Clean
Pu piw pam haqam kitsókiveniqw, hak tāqa ahsupoq tokoplelet tūtuya, nihqe pam Jesus túwahqe, tayway akw atpipo munukt, aw nāwaknaqe paṅqawu: Tutuyqawhqa, um suhtaq’ewnen soon nuy qa powatani.
Noqw pam put aw māvuyaltiqe, aw toṅokt, paṅqawu: Pay nu suhtaq’ewa; powaltii. Noqw pahsat pay tokoplele put mātavi.

Noqw pam qa hakiy put āawnaniqat pam aw paṅqawu. Nīk̇aṅw pay um ahpiynen God awwat moṅwit aw nāmahtaknani; nen Moses hin tutaptaqat anwat um powaltiqey ep kuwahtiput távini. Um pan powaltiqey nuhtumi tuawi’tani, yan aw lavayhti.
Noqw tuwat soq pahsat pu pas ahsupoq pam hin hinhtiqa yuaatiwa, noqw sinom qaan’ewakw hintaqam Jesus aw tūqayyuṅwniqe sūmitsovalti; pu hīhihta tūtuyyaqam put ahpiy qalaptuyaniqe ōviy put aw ökiwta.
Noqw pay pam haqami qayēsiwhpuminen, God aw nāwakintaniqey ōviy kīṅaqw ahpiyniṅwu.
Jesus Heals a Paralyzed Man

Pu Jesus hisat sinmuy tutuqaynaqw ima Pharisee‐sinom, tutavot tutuqaynayaqamuy amumum pep yēse. Puma Galileet aṅ ahsupoq kitsókit aṅqwya, pu Judeat aṅq’ö, pu Jerusalem aṅq’ö. Noqw pumuy pep yesq, Jesus Tutuyqawhqat aw yank̇aṅw tūqalaptsintaniqey öqalay’ta.
Noqw meh, hakim hakiy tāqat ahpa’ qataytaqat tūtuyhqat ahpay aṅ qatsqat Jesus aw wikvaya; noqw puma as hin put panaye’, Jesus atpipo taviyaniqey tuwantota.
Noqw ep huru’pokiwtaqw hin puma put panayaniqey qa tutwa; nihqe ōviy kits’omiq wupnayaqe, tsöqa’wa kīamit póroknayaqe paṅ put ahpayat enaṅ sinsonmi Jesus atpipo hawnaya.
Noqw puma qapēvewnayaqat Jesus amumi túwahqe paṅqawu: Tāqa, uhqaanhtipu uhpiy ayo yukiwa.
Noqw tutavot tutuqaynayaqam Pharisee‐sinmuy amumum put ep wūwantotaqe paṅqaqwa: Ya i’ haknihqe pas God qa k̇aptsilawu? Ya hak hakiy qaanhtipuyat ayo yúkuni, hal pas God‐saa?
Noqw Jesus pumuy wuwniyamuy māmatsqe, lavayhtiqe amumi paṅqawu: Ya uma hihta umuh’unaṅwpeq wūwantota?
Ya hak hakiy aw hinwat lavayhtiniqw qa pas hinta, Sen, Uhqaanhtipu uhpiy ayo yukiwa kítaniqö’? sen pi wunuptut, nakwsuu, kítaniqö’?

Noqw pay pi nu’ Sinot Tiat yep qatsit ep hakiy ahpiy qaanhtipuyat ayo yúkuniqey aw öqalat pasiwtaqat uma it akw nanaptaniqw‐pu pam it hakiy ahpa’ qataytaqat aw paṅqawu: Oviy nu ūmi paṅqawni: Wunuptut, uh’ahpay kwusut, nimaa.
Noqw pahsat pay pam pumuy amutpik wunuptut, hihta aṅ wáökiwtaqey kwusut, paṅqw nima, God pas hihtatimak̇aṅwo.
Noqw sinom sohsoyam k̇ātayuṅqe, God pas hihtatota, nihqe puma nātsawini’yuṅqe paṅqaqwa: Pas itam pu’ hihta qatuptsiwni’ewakw aw yórikya.
Jesus Calls Levi
It yantaqat atsve pam nakwsukaṅw, hakiy moṅwit eṅem sīvat ömalawhqat, Levit yan mātsiwhqat aw yori, haqam put ömalawṅwuqat ep qátuq’ö, nihqe aw paṅqawu: Um inuṅkni.
Noqw pam sohsok mātapt, wunuptut, put aṅki.
Noqw Levi put eṅem wukonovata; noqw k̇aysiwhqam sīvat ömalalwaqam‐niqw pu hakim pumuy amumum pep nopyesva.

Noqw Pharisee‐sinom‐niqw, pu pumuy amuṅaqw tutavot tutuqaynayaqam, puma put aw nánatuwnayaqamuy amumi qayan unaṅway hiṅqaqwaqe paṅqaqwa: Ya uma hinoqw moṅwit eṅem sīvat ömalalwaqamuy‐nik̇aṅw pu qaanhinwisqamuy amumum nōnovak̇ahk̇aṅw hīhikwya?
Noqw Jesus lavayhtiqe amumi paṅqawu: Pay aṅ qahinyuṅqam tūhik̇at qa haqni’yuṅwa, nawus pi tūtuyyaqam put haqni’yuṅwa.
Pi nu aṅ súanhinwisqamuy qa pumuy wáṅwayniqe ōviy pitu; pi nu imuy qaanhinwisqamuy nāp tunatyay aṅqw lasyaniqat aw wáṅwayniqe ōviy pitu.
The Question about Fasting

Noqw puma put aw paṅqawu: John aw nánatuwnayaqam pas nanapwalk̇ahk̇aṅw nānawaknaṅwu, noqw Pharisee‐sinmuy amumi nánatuwnayaqam amún hinwisa. Noqw hintaqw ōviy ūmi nánatuwnayaqam nōnovak̇ahk̇aṅw hīhikwya?
Noqw pam pumuy amumi paṅqawu: Ya hak sen haqam mö’wit ep sinoiwyuṅqamuy, möönaṅwuy pumuy amumumniqw napwaltoynani? Soon’i.
Nīk̇aṅw ason hisat aw pituqw, möönaṅw’am pumuy amuṅaqw ahpiyniqw, pep pu’ puma nānapwalani.

Noqw pam piw pumuy amumi lavayit hihta antaqat akw yuaaykuqe paṅqawu: Qa haq pi hak puhuyuwsit aṅqw hihsaqat tukut, sakwit aw pihtakna. Taq hak panhtinik puhut sakwítani, piw pūhu soon sakwit amum súnantani.
Pu qa haq pi hak puk̇awiwkorot sakwíiwmaqat puhuovavalat kuhkuya; taq hakiy pantiniqw, puhuovavala pēke’, wiwkorot patomnani, nen aṅ kūyiwtaqa wehemhtini, noqw wiwkorot sakwítini.
Soon pi puhuovavala qa puhuwiwkorot aṅ kūyiltiṅwu.
Piw qa hak pi hak ovavalat hísatwaiwhput hikwt, pay pahsat pūhutwat piw nāwaknaṅwu; nīk̇aṅw paṅqawṅwu: Pay hísatwat pas nukṅwa, kītaṅwu.
